issue: Immediate DoS / Thread Panic via synchronous `block_on` in active Tokio runtime threads during lazy loading.
recommendation: Refactor `ModelManager::embed` and `ModelManager::embed_batch` to be asynchronous (`async fn`). Avoid calling `block_on` inside the active Tokio executor pool, as it triggers an immediate runtime panic.

issue: Local Privilege Escalation / Arbitrary Code Execution via loading unverified model files from a shared/world-writable cache directory.
recommendation: Secure the default model directory `/var/lib/op-dbus/models` with strict Unix permissions (`0700` owned by the service user). Implement cryptographic hash verification (SHA-256) of downloaded `model.onnx` and `tokenizer.json` files prior to committing them to the ONNX session.

issue: Schema-as-Code & OSCAL Gap: Ad-hoc configuration representation without machine-readable schema constraint validation.
recommendation: Migrate `VectorizationConfig` into a versioned Protocol Buffer schema or OSCAL-compliant component definition. Enforce constraint boundaries on parsing (e.g., validating that `batch_size > 0` and `num_threads` is within system limits) to prevent division-by-zero or resource exhaustion.

issue: CPU & Thread Starvation via concurrent multi-threaded ONNX Runtime Session allocations.
recommendation: Bound `num_threads` dynamically instead of defaulting blindly to `num_cpus::get()` per session. Configure a shared, global thread pool for the ONNX Runtime sessions to prevent excessive thread context-switching overhead under concurrent loads.

issue: Incompatible Tensor Names & Fallback Panic during model fallback procedures.
recommendation: Implement model-agnostic output extraction. If the fallback model lacks a `"sentence_embedding"` tensor, dynamically check for and parse `"last_hidden_state"` with mean-pooling to prevent runtime extraction failures.
